source.paper: Parker, Stewart, Boore, Atkinson & Hassani (2020) PEER 2020/03; Parker et al. (2022) Earthquake Spectra 38(2) 845-870
source.basis: scalar transcription of the hazardlib implementation (ParkerEtAl2020SInter / ParkerEtAl2020SSlab, basin term off, no epistemic sigma_mu, no AK23 bias adjustment; independent of physics.js); regenerate by re-transcribing if hazardlib updates

units: lnA: pga/SA = ln(median in g), pgv = ln(median in cm/s) — hazardlib native; sigma/tau/phi in ln units. physics.js pgaParker2022 converts g -> gal with 980.665
